title: Require a calibration on the added memory and readout instrument
statement: An extra sqrt(2 gamma)|S+><S+| dephaser leaves the original S-/D optical coherence unchanged while changing added ground-memory coherences. Thus the source optical Ramsey/visibility fit does not identify gamma or the new full instrument. The source magnetic/trap-noise assumption admits a conditional f1,gamma0 extension, but neither that assumption nor its two-level fit acquires the new calibration.
